name: Girls5eva
description: When a one-hit-wonder girl group from the '90s gets sampled by a young rapper, its members reunite to give their pop star dreams one more shot. They may be grown women balancing spouses, kids, jobs, debt, aging parents and shoulder pain, but can't they also be Girls5Eva?

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The members of Girls5eva, a 90s girl group, reconnect.

videos.overview: The group performs at a fan's nostalgic party where Dawn reckons with the past, Summer looks to right a wrong, and Wickie runs into an old flame.

videos.title: Cleveland
videos.overview: When Gloria learns her friend isn't who he appears to be, G5E work to seize an opportunity for their tour. A paparazzi photo stirs up a scandal.

videos.title: New York
videos.overview: With ticket sales low and tensions high, the group hustles to save their Radio City Music Hall show — but their friendship hangs in the balance.

awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 43 nominations total
